---

config:
    theme: 'base'
    themeVariables:
        primaryColor: '#1f2020'
        primaryTextColor: '#f0f0f0'
        background: '#333'
        primaryBorderColor: '#888888'
        lineColor: '#999'

---

stateDiagram

normal

normal : normal

insert

insert : insert

visual

visual : visual

command

command : command

replace

replace : replace

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

normal --> insert : on_i

normal --> insert : on_a

normal --> insert : on_o

normal --> visual : on_v

normal --> command : on_colon

normal --> replace : on_shift_r

insert --> normal : on_escape

visual --> normal : on_escape

command --> normal : on_escape

command --> normal : on_enter

replace --> normal : on_escape

ROOT.(InitialState) --> normal
